mapper.select: SELECT C_PROJECT_SEQ SEQ, S_COMPANY_NM COMPANY_NM, C_START_DY START_DY, C_END_DY END_DY, C_ING_YN ING_YN, S_GRADE_NM GRADE_NM, S_SMALL_CONT SMALL_CONT, S_EXP_DETAIL EXP_DETAIL, C_USE_YN USE_YN FROM T_LD_EXPERIENCE_INFO ORDER BY C_ING_YN DESC, C_START_DY DESC

SELECT C_PROJECT_SEQ SEQ, S_COMPANY_NM COMPANY_NM, C_START_DY START_DY, C_END_DY END_DY, C_ING_YN ING_YN, S_GRADE_NM GRADE_NM, S_SMALL_CONT SMALL_CONT, S_EXP_DETAIL EXP_DETAIL, C_USE_YN USE_YN FROM T_LD_EXPERIENCE_INFO WHERE C_PROJECT_SEQ = #{seq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_LD_EXPERIENCE_INFO (C_PROJECT_SEQ, S_COMPANY_NM, C_START_DY, C_END_DY, C_ING_YN, S_GRADE_NM, S_SMALL_CONT, S_EXP_DETAIL, C_USE_YN, S_REG_ID, D_REG_DT) SELECT IFNULL(MAX(C_PROJECT_SEQ), 0) + 1, #{companyNm}, #{startDy}, #{endDy}, #{ingYn}, #{gradeNm}, #{smallCont}, #{expDetail}, 'Y', 'admin', NOW() FROM T_LD_EXPERIENCE_INFO
mapper.update: UPDATE T_LD_EXPERIENCE_INFO SET S_COMPANY_NM = #{companyNm}, C_START_DY = #{startDy}, C_END_DY = #{endDy}, C_ING_YN = #{ingYn}, S_GRADE_NM = #{gradeNm}, S_SMALL_CONT = #{smallCont}, S_EXP_DETAIL = #{expDetail} WHERE C_PROJECT_SEQ = #{seq}
UPDATE T_LD_EXPERIENCE_INFO SET C_USE_YN = 'N' WHERE C_PROJECT_SEQ = #{seq}
UPDATE T_LD_EXPERIENCE_INFO SET C_USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE C_PROJECT_SEQ = #{seq}
